evidence_policy: Do not infer campaign equipment, aircraft complements, capabilities or geography-based routes from real-world history or names. Report estimates and forecasts are not confirmed events. Before recommending an attack, intercept, route or arrival time, obtain evidence for the needed capabilities and constraints; otherwise identify the unknowns and offer checks or conditional options. For specific aircraft, quantities or loadouts, report retrieved names and numbers directly, not vague substitutes. Explain readiness in the requested language, without raw field names. Identify contacts by observed kind, position, count and observation time. Ground/garrison strength is a campaign abstraction, not a tactical vehicle count. Missing stock records or location references are unknown, not zero or empty. A known opposing airbase does not reveal hidden aircraft or scripted reinforcements.
retrieval: For broad priorities, retrieve relevant enabled orders/reports and current forces, relating advice to victory objectives. Retrieve friendly air-unit details before naming aircraft or proposing air operations. For defense, capture or replenishment, request own ground/base details. get_bases accepts public base IDs but returns only currently player-owned details; opposing sightings use get_base_observations.
aviation_semantics: Respect campaign_launch_supported, displayed_launch_blocked, readiness states and deck-cycle limits. A known launch block is a confirmed current restriction; other sortie feasibility can remain unknown. Land total includes airborne aircraft. Carrier nominal_complement is a reference, not current strength; aboard excludes allocated arming/airborne aircraft. ready_unarmed needs preparation. available_for_preparation means ready to START preparation, excludes cooling and does not prove an armed, launchable sortie. Unsupported carrier types have null operational counts. Flight entries overlap unit counts; do not sum them. Selected/selectable loadout names do not prove current weapon stocks, fuel, range, capabilities or mission feasibility.
error_ids_count: {0} must be a nonempty array of up to {1} IDs.
error_round_limit: No further query rounds are available.
error_wrong_consultation: Use the current consultation_id; IDs from another snapshot cannot be reused.
error_request_too_large: Reduce the number or size of query arguments.
error_query_object_invalid: Each query must be an object.
error_response_too_large: Use smaller pages, fewer IDs, or include_ships=false.
error_payload_limit: The consultation payload budget is exhausted.
error_information_disabled: This data category is disabled by the user. Do not request it through another query.
error_ships_disabled: Ship details are disabled by the user.
error_unknown_ship: An ID does not name an own ship in this consultation.
error_force_filter_disabled: Force filters are disabled by the user.
error_air_filters_conflict: Use either force_ids or base_ids for air-unit filtering.
error_unknown_base: Only this snapshot's own base details are available here.
error_unknown_ground_unit: Only own snapshot-local ground-unit IDs are available.
error_unknown_query: The query is not in the knowledge catalog.
error_unknown_force: An ID does not name an own force in this consultation.
error_unknown_id: An ID is not available for this query in this consultation.
error_unsupported_argument: The query contains an unsupported argument.
catalog_friendly_task_forces: Own force identities, positions and ship counts.
catalog_friendly_ships: Own ship identities, types and enabled status sections.
catalog_friendly_air_units: Own land squadrons/carrier wings: host, types, counts, readiness and displayed launch constraints.
catalog_friendly_air_flights: Own airborne flight identities, positions, counts, selected loadout and return state.
catalog_observed_contacts: Observed contacts, observation time and uncertainty.
catalog_public_bases: Public base identities/ownership; IDs match victory objectives.
catalog_friendly_bases: Own base capacity, shipyard, recorded stocks and enabled garrison strength. IDs from list_bases.
catalog_friendly_ground_units: Own ground identities, campaign strength and disclosed base/transport.
catalog_published_orders: Published own orders and briefing text.
catalog_recent_player_reports: Retained player-report metadata; body by ID.
tool_description: Query the current player-known campaign snapshot. Supply a requests batch; the host binds the consultation.
tool_ids: get_* only: current IDs of the requested entity type.
tool_force_ids: list_ships/list_air_units: optional force filter; air units selects hosted wings.
tool_base_ids: list_air_units: land squadrons at these public bases; incompatible with force_ids.
tool_offset: Zero-based list offset. List queries only.
tool_limit: List page size. Omit for the default page size.
tool_include_ships: get_forces: true includes individual ships; omitted/false returns force details only.
tool_kind: list_reports only: a report kind code.
byte_counting: Compact JSON UTF-8 bytes for the initial input and successful query responses. Error envelopes are excluded. Not a token or billing limit.
victory_description: The first side to hold all of its objective bases wins. Its own bases must also be held. Each side's objective list already applies opposing-homeland and side-specific exemptions.
